name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem

angles.text: As a druid, receiving a summons to confer with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem carries special weight, as he leads your order in Thunder Bluff.
As a tauren, stepping up to assist the arch druid on the Elder Rise honors one of your people's most respected elders.

faq.answer: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem and the Cenarion Circle are seeking seasoned adventurers for an important inquiry.
faq.q: Who is looking for help in Thunder Bluff?

faq.answer: He can be found on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
The Cenarion Circle is conducting a vital research project, though the details are disclosed only to those who meet Hamuul directly.
faq.q: What kind of work is Hamuul Runetotem conducting?

sections.body: Word has spread across the city that the Cenarion Circle requires outside aid. If you choose to answer the call, you will find Hamuul Runetotem gathered with his fellow druids on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. The arch druid keeps the exact nature of his study quiet until you present yourself in person.
sections.title: A Summons to the Mesa

summary: The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is seeking seasoned adventurers for an urgent inquiry. Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem leads the effort from atop the mesa, though the details of his work remain closely held.
